decisions.reason: After several years on the market this component line appears to have enough technical fit and low continuation cost within the firm's drainage family that management would keep it unless demand clearly weakens.
As a flagship designer drainage line that matches the firm's strategic direction toward integrated and design-conscious shower solutions, it remains highly unlikely to be withdrawn.
The integrated sloped shower element still complements the firm's system offering and installation-ease proposition, so the option value of keeping it available remains higher than abandoning it.
Although more niche than the core shower lines, its clear technical problem-solving role in drainage makes it worth retaining while it continues to serve a specialized segment.
